```{python}
#| echo: false
import pandas as pd

sights = pd.read_csv("data/sights.csv")
wide = sights.pivot(index="sight", columns="fact", values="value")
order = ["British Museum", "Natural History Museum", "Tate Modern", "National Gallery", "Tower of London"]
wide = wide.loc[order]
```

![Elizabeth Tower (Big Ben) against the sky. Photo: John Dillenbeck, CC0, via Wikimedia Commons.](images/big-ben.jpg){width=35% fig-alt="The clock tower of the Palace of Westminster, known as Big Ben, seen against the sky."}

## Five sights to start with

```{python}
#| echo: false
#| output: asis
for sight, r in wide.iterrows():
    print(f"- **{sight}**: {r['price_band']}, nearest tube {r['nearest_tube']}")
```

## Tip from a local

> Walk along the Thames at sunset: the views from the South Bank are free and unforgettable.
